newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay president fires officers over uprising.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay president fires officers over uprising.

text.p: Paraguayan President Juan Carlos Wasmosy on Tuesday fired 225 soldiers on disciplinary grounds for supporting rebel Gen. Lino Oviedo in a barracks uprising in April, a presidential spokesman said.
The officers and non-commissioned officers will be officially discharged by presidential decree effective on Thursday.
Oviedo holed himself up in his barracks just outside Asuncion on April 22 after Wasmosy ordered his discharge.

The deadlock was broken after the president apparently backed down and offered Oviedo the post of defence minister. But the apparent victory for Oviedo was converted into an embarrassing defeat after it turned out he had been fooled and the general was stripped of his rank and put on trial.
The judicial investigation to determine whether the events in April were an attempted coup d'etat is still continuing. Oviedo says he was not trying to overthrow Wasmosy.
The Paraguayan Congress also formed a special commission to investigate the uprising after Oviedo said top businessmen had offered him the presidency.
